name: Departures Second Engine
source:
With dream and courage main character sets off for an adventure. He has to come over numerous trials to discover the secret behind the maritime Empire.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
懷抱夢想與勇氣，主角踏上冒險旅程。他必須克服無數考驗，揭開海洋帝國背後的秘密。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
